info.title: data-avalanche management API
info.description: `globals.api.auth` decides which credentials a node takes: none, basic (one user, admin), or a bearer JWT whose roles are mapped (config §6.3).

post.summary: Shut down: leave the cluster, then end the process

requestBody.description: `note`: why, kept with the action's event (optional, at most 500 characters)

parameters.description: the generation compared from

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: the generation compared to

get.summary: The config generations, newest first: who published each, why, and what it changed

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: generations older than this one: the `next` of the page before

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: at most this many (1–100, 20 by default)

200.description: the generations, each `hash` its text's keyed fingerprint (comparable across nodes of one cluster only), and `next` when the page is full

400.description: a parameter that isn't one, or isn't in its form

401.description: no credentials, or ones that don't verify

403.description: the caller's role is below the route's

get.summary: One config generation and its text, its secrets masked and its comments shown empty

parameters.name: generation
parameters.description: a config generation's number

200.description: the generation and its text, a URL's credentials masked (`••••••@`) and every comment shown empty (`#`); `hash` is the text's keyed fingerprint, comparable across nodes of one cluster only

400.description: a generation that isn't a number

401.description: no credentials, or ones that don't verify

403.description: the caller's role is below the route's

404.description: no such generation

409.description: several snapshots of it and no record of which one it is

500.description: its text couldn't be masked, so it isn't shown: it has a merge key (`<<`), a tag (a `!` after a space), a directive or a byte-order mark, or a secret or a comment the masker can't place

503.description: the node is starting or stopping, or its state can't be read; or the config generations can't be read

get.summary: The cluster's events and audit trail, newest first: actions with who took them, lease hand-offs, halts, schema changes, snapshot jobs, members, config generations

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: events at or after this time (RFC 3339)

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: events before this time (RFC 3339)

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: a kind or a family (`action`, `lease.takeover`); repeat it for several

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: a pipeline's id, or an object's name (a table, a job, a node)

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: the name of who caused it

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: the node that recorded it

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: text in the event or its note, without case

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: at most this many (1–1000, 100 by default)

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: the `next` of the page before: go on from there

200.description: the events, and `next` when there are more

400.description: a parameter that isn't one, or isn't in its form

401.description: no credentials, or ones that don't verify

403.description: the caller's role is below the route's

get.summary: The series the nodes sampled, over a range: a pipeline's, a table's or a node's, from any node

parameters.name: pipeline
parameters.description: a pipeline's id, or several comma-separated; without it or `node`, every pipeline

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: a table of the one pipeline asked, as its config key: the table's series

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: a node's name: the node's series

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: the series, comma-separated; by default every series of what is asked

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: from this time (RFC 3339); an hour before `until` by default

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: to this time (RFC 3339); now by default

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: seconds between points; by default, and at the finest, the samples' own, coarsened to at most 1440 points

200.description: each series' points, `[unix seconds, value]`, oldest first; `kept_since`: where the history kept starts

400.description: a parameter that isn't one, or isn't in its form
